decision: Five design languages on one semantic token contract
why: Users and postures differ; semantics, accessibility and components should not.
alternative: One universal theme for every system.
value: Distinct products without forking components; contrast is tested per theme.

decision: Systems share contracts, events and identity, not pixels
why: Consistency matters where data crosses boundaries, not in button colour.
value: Teams move independently without breaking each other.

decision: The AI surface is re-skinned only by radius and type
why: Trust patterns must be recognisable in every system.
alternative: Let each team design AI UI freely.
value: Users learn 'Simulated AI + sources + approve' once.

decision: Tokens live in one JSON source that generates CSS and TypeScript
why: Docs, code and tests must read the same values.
value: The swatches on this page are the production values.
